```plato
//==
// # Distribution interface
//
// The single interface the univariate distributions of `random.types.plato`
// implement. Its four obligations are discharged per type across
// `random.library.plato`; the derived surface built on top of it
// (StandardDeviation, SurvivalAt, ProbabilityBetween, ...) lives with the other
// interface traits in `random.library.plato`.

// A univariate probability distribution over the real line
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Probability_distribution). Pdf is the
// probability density (or mass, for discrete distributions) at a value;
// Cdf is the cumulative probability of drawing at most that value.
interface IProbabilityDistribution
    inherits IValue
{
    Mean(x: Self): Number;
    Variance(x: Self): Number;
    Pdf(x: Self, value: Number): Number;
    Cdf(x: Self, value: Number): Number;
}
```
